title: EUCOM Hosts Component Commanders Conference in Stuttgart, Discusses 'NATO 3.0 Posture Review' and 'Cooperative Burden Shifting'
detail: U.S. Air Force Gen. Alexus G. Grynkewich, commander of U.S. European Command, hosted his senior staff, component commanders and other key leaders at the EUCOM Component Commanders Conference at EUCOM headquarters in Stuttgart, Germany on September 2–3, 2026. The in-person gathering coordinates and synchronizes activities among EUCOM's headquarters and its six service components toward shared national and European security objectives. Discussion highlights listed by EUCOM included the 'NATO 3.0 Posture Review,' 'NATO Cooperative Burden Shifting,' and the 'NATO U.S. – European Defense Industrial Base: Scoping, Scaling, Sealing, Sustaining Through Conflict' — placing the same terminology used by Pentagon policy chief Elbridge Colby's force-posture review at the center of EUCOM's own internal planning ahead of the September 18 decision briefing to Colby and the November 6 deadline for troop-level options to Defense Secretary Hegseth.
